message.content:
An editorial illustration features a caricature of a man wearing glasses and a red jacket over a black shirt and trousers. He is hunched forward, plugging his ears with both index fingers while grimacing. His ankles are bound by several coils of brown rope that extend horizontally across the frame. Above him, the rope winds through the air, trailing behind a small white van with "KPK" and "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi" printed on its side. The van also has a red and white license plate that reads "K PK".

The illustration is part of a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black capital letters. Text at the top reads "Pembungkaman Kritik di Senayan H.32" and "Ancaman Krisis Gas Industri H.78". Beside the man, bold text reads "SAATNYA BUKA-BUKAAN", followed by a paragraph starting with "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi ditengarai mencari beking politik...". The bottom right corner contains a barcode, QR code, and publication details including the date "6-12 JANUARI 2025" and the price "RP 60.000".
